nutrients.title: Protein
nutrients.basis: US pregnancy reference, ages 14–50; an individual target depends on body size and health.
nutrients.summary: Include a protein food at meals to support growth and tissue repair.

nutrients.title: Iron
nutrients.basis: US pregnancy reference; this is a total dietary intake reference, not a tablet dose.
nutrients.summary: Iron supports oxygen transport. Pair plant sources with vitamin-C-rich foods to help absorption.

nutrients.title: Calcium
nutrients.basis: US pregnancy reference for ages 19–50; ages 14–18: 1,300 mg / day.
nutrients.summary: Calcium supports bones and teeth. Check calcium amounts on fortified-food labels.

nutrients.title: Folate
nutrients.basis: US pregnancy reference. DFE means dietary folate equivalents; it is not the same as a folic-acid tablet dose.
nutrients.summary: Folate supports cell division. Food sources complement, rather than replace, prescribed folic acid.
